title: Let Your Glory Be over All the Earth

questions.question: Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me, for in you my soul takes what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:1 (ESV): "Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me, for in you my soul takes refuge;"

questions.question: In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge, till the storms of destruction pass where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:1 (ESV): "in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge, till the storms of destruction pass by."

questions.question: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:2 (ESV): "I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for me."

questions.question: He will send from heaven and save me; he will put to shame him who tramples on whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:3 (ESV): "...he will put to shame him who tramples on me."

questions.question: God will send out his steadfast love and his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:3 (ESV): "God will send out his steadfast love and his faithfulness!"

questions.question: My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie down amid fiery beasts—the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:4 (ESV): "...the children of man, whose teeth are spears and arrows,"

questions.question: Whose teeth are spears and arrows, their tongues sharp what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:4 (ESV): "...whose teeth are spears and arrows, their tongues sharp swords."

questions.question: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:5 (ESV): "Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth!"

questions.question: They set a net for my steps; my soul was bowed what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:6 (ESV): "They set a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down."

questions.question: They dug a pit in my way, but they have fallen into it whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:6 (ESV): "They dug a pit in my way, but they have fallen into it themselves."

questions.question: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast! I will sing and make what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:7 (ESV): "My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast! I will sing and make melody!"

questions.question: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:8 (ESV): "Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn!"

questions.question: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises to you among the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:9 (ESV): "...I will sing praises to you among the nations."

questions.question: For your steadfast love is great to the heavens, your faithfulness to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57:10 (ESV): "For your steadfast love is great to the heavens, your faithfulness to the clouds."

questions.question: This Psalm was written when David fled from Saul, in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 57 Title: "...when he fled from Saul, in the cave."

key_verse_text: Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me, for in you my soul takes refuge; in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge, till the storms of destruction pass by.
